item.title: Trump says U.S. is postponing some strikes as it negotiates end to war with Iran
item.summary: The president’s announcement sent markets up and energy prices diving, as investors bet Iran’s blockade of a key shipping chokepoint could soon end.

item.title: Joe Kent says he wants Trump to hear MAGA opposition to Iran war
item.summary: In an interview with The Post after resigning from the administration in protest, the veteran said he is taking his message to the president’s supporters.

item.title: Trump hails Memphis crime drop as a win. Locals see a more complex reality.
item.summary: Crime has fallen, but officials and residents question how much credit the federal surge deserves — and whether the approach can deliver lasting change.

item.title: Trump installs Christopher Columbus statue on White House grounds
item.summary: The president has condemned efforts to take down statues of Columbus and other historical figures, saying the removals are an “assault on our collective national memory.”

item.title: Trump just voted by a method he calls ‘mail-in cheating’
item.summary: The president’s decision to vote by mail comes as he pushes a sweeping bill to reform balloting nationwide, including restrictions on mail-in voting.

item.title: Supreme Court appears ready to limit mail-in balloting ahead of midterms
item.summary: Republican groups challenged a law in Mississippi that allows officials to count mail-in ballots received up to five days after polls close.

item.title: Republicans privately fear this swing state Democrat
item.summary: Behind closed doors, Republicans have tamped down their hopes of unseating Jon Ossoff, a 39-year-old powerhouse fundraiser, as he seeks another term.

item.title: Trump says he will deploy ICE to airports as TSA shortages drive delays
item.summary: Border czar Tom Homan said ICE agents will be at airports to help TSA agents, but he does not expect they will do specialized tasks, such as X-ray screening.

item.title: He was Rubio’s friend and roommate. Now Rubio will testify against him.
item.summary: Former congressman David Rivera, accused of secretly lobbying for Nicolás Maduro’s government in Venezuela, climbed Miami politics alongside Marco Rubio.

item.title: New top prosecutor named in New Jersey, ending impasse over U.S attorney’s office
item.summary: Robert Frazer replaces a trio of officials the Justice Department installed to lead the office late last year — an arrangement a federal judge ruled was illegal.
